newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moody's lifts Queensland outlook to improving.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moody's lifts Queensland outlook to improving.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday it has revised the outlook for the Australian state of Queensland's foreign currency debt rating to improving from stable.
However, the ratings agency said the change was due only to the revised outlook for Australia's foreign currency rating.

"The revision does not reflect a change in Queensland's credit fundamental, but solely reflects the change in the outlook of the country ceiling for Australia's foreign currency debt," it said in a statement.
Queensland's senior unsecured foreign currency debt rating is AA2. Its senior unsecured domestic currency rating is AAA.

Moody's said on Wednesday that the outlook for Australia's AA2 foreign currency debt had improved, citing the government's steady fiscal policy framework and the central bank's prudent monetary policy stance.
